title: avnac: a local-first browser design editor for posters and social graphics
description:
avnac is Canva spelled backwards. A lightning-fast browser-first design editor for posters, layouts, and social graphics. Local-first architecture. Everything happens on your machine, autosaved to IndexedDB. Multi-select, group alignment, nested vector drawing areas, image cropping, custom shadows, native QR code generation. Built-in Magic Panel brings prompt-driven AI editing straight into your local canvas.

https://github.com/akinloluwami/avnac

#github #opensource
